Both have now been tuned against, so a genuinely clean generalization number needs a NEW set3 -- build one the same way rather than re-quoting these.

_finding: Four sets, measured first-exposure BEFORE any tuning against them: set2 33.3%, set3 55.6%, set4 47.8% -- mean ~45%. After tuning, the same sets read 76.5% and 81.5%. A keyword/lexicon classifier plateaus near 50% on these bios; each tuning round buys ~25-30pp on its own set and ~5-13pp on fresh data. Build set5 the same way before quoting any new number, and do not read 60.9% as clean -- set4 has now been tuned against.
